The '''Eight-Hour Invasion of Dubrillion''' was a battle of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. It was a surprise attack from [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] against the relatively unprotected planet of [[Dubrillion/Legends|Dubrillion]]. However, the few Republic troops there repelled the Sith invasion force with minimal reinforcements for eight hours. After this time, the arrival of a massive amount of [[Republic soldier]]s forced the Imperial forces to withdraw.

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Felix Iresso]] participated in this battle.
